sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年丙辰

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 1, bingchen.
translations.idiomatic: The first year of the Jiaqing reign (bingchen).

sentences.zh: 六月遷。署。

translations.literal: Sixth month: transferred. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was transferred and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰赴寧剿匪。暫署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: went to Ning to suppress bandits. Temporarily acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month he went to Ning to suppress bandits and served temporarily in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯卒。代。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: died. Replacement.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the sixth month he died and was succeeded by a replacement.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥兩廣總督。八月辛丑降。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Governor-General of Liangguang. Eighth month, day xinchou: demoted. Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month he became Governor-General of Liangguang. On the xinchou day of the eighth month he was demoted to Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅降。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin: demoted. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month he was demoted to Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年丁巳

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 2, dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of the Jiaqing reign (dingsi).

sentences.zh: 九月甲申遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: transferred. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the ninth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑革。代。十月陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yichou: dismissed from office. Replacement. Tenth month: Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fifth month he was dismissed from office and succeeded by a replacement. In the tenth month [the successor became] Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 降。五月乙丑兼辦四川總督事務。十月遷。

translations.literal: Demoted. Fifth month, day yichou: concurrently handled Sichuan governor-general affairs. Tenth month: transferred.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted. On the yichou day of the fifth month he concurrently handled Sichuan governor-general affairs. In the tenth month he was transferred.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳卒。署。九月己丑湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinsi: died. Acting. Ninth month, day jichou: Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the seventh month he died; [his successor served] in an acting capacity. On the jichou day of the ninth month [the acting appointee became] Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: transferred. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the ninth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申卒。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: died. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the twelfth month he died; [the post passed to] Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申遷。任。十二月戊申遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: transferred. In post. Twelfth month, day wushen: transferred. Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the ninth month he was transferred and took up his duties. On the wushen day of the twelfth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年戊午

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 3, wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: The third year of the Jiaqing reign (wuwu).

sentences.zh: 正月庚午遷。直隸總督。

translations.literal: First month, day gengwu: transferred. Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the first month he was transferred to Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 正月甲申四川總督。

translations.literal: First month, day jiashen: Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the first month he became Governor-General of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子憂免。暫署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: dismissed on account of mourning. Temporarily acting Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the eleventh month he was dismissed on account of mourning; [another] temporarily acted as Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 正月甲申遷。三月癸酉湖廣總督。

translations.literal: First month, day jiashen: transferred. Third month, day guiyou: Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the first month he was transferred. On the guiyou day of the third month he became Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅卒。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiayin: died. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the sixth month he died while serving as Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiayin: transferred. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the sixth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 假。署。

translations.literal: On leave. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: He was on leave of absence and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年己未

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 4, jiwei.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of the Jiaqing reign (jiwei).

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑卒。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinchou: died. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the second month he died while serving as Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 正月丙戌免。署。二月己丑陝甘總督。

translations.literal: First month, day bingxu: dismissed. Acting. Second month, day jichou: Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the first month he was dismissed; [another] served in an acting capacity. On the jichou day of the second month [the appointee became] Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉革。署四川總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guiyou: dismissed from office. Acting Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the seventh month he was dismissed from office and served as acting Governor-General of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子調。兼署。十月戊子閩浙總督。署。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: transferred. Concurrently acting. Tenth month, day wuzi: Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the third month he was transferred and served concurrently in an acting capacity. On the wuzi day of the tenth month he became acting Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午來京。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu: came to the capital. Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the third month he came to the capital [while holding the post of] Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳憂免。雲貴總督。十月戊子遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: dismissed on account of mourning. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. Tenth month, day wuzi: transferred. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the eighth month he was dismissed on account of mourning from the post of Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. On the wuzi day of the tenth month [another] was transferred to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申免。漕運總督。十二月壬辰免。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: dismissed. Governor-General of Grain Transport. Twelfth month, day renchen: dismissed. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the second month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Grain Transport. On the renchen day of the twelfth month he was again dismissed from that same post.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌實授。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu: formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the eleventh month he received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶五年庚申

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 5, gengshen.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth year of the Jiaqing reign (gengshen).

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥假。護。戊戌，直隸總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: on leave. Guarded [the post]. Day wuxu: Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the ninth month he was on leave and another guarded the post for him. On wuxu day he became Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 正月辛酉遷。陝甘總督。

translations.literal: First month, day xinyou: transferred. Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the first month he was transferred to Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳革。四川總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the third month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 正月辛酉遷。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: First month, day xinyou: transferred. Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the first month he was transferred to Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 正月丁丑免。湖廣總督。署。九月戊戌湖廣總督。

translations.literal: First month, day dingchou: dismissed. Governor-General of Huguang. Acting. Ninth month, day wuxu: Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the first month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Huguang; [another] served in an acting capacity. On the wuxu day of the ninth month [the acting appointee became] Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuxu: transferred. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the ninth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子革。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the second month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: transferred. Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the second month he was transferred to Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年辛酉

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 6, xinyou.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth year of the Jiaqing reign (xinyou).

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅革。署。九月直隸總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiayin: dismissed from office. Acting. Ninth month: Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the sixth month he was dismissed from office; [another] served in an acting capacity. In the ninth month [the appointee became] Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑來京。陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: came to the capital. Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the eleventh month he came to the capital [while holding the post of] Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 卒。四月壬戌湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Died. Fourth month, day renxu: Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He died. On the renxu day of the fourth month [the successor became] Governor-General of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年壬戌

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 7, renxu.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of the Jiaqing reign (renxu).

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑病免。暫署。甲辰，署直隸總督。九月己巳實授。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinchou: dismissed on account of illness. Temporarily acting. Day jiachen: acting Governor-General of Zhili. Ninth month, day jisi: formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the fourth month he was dismissed on account of illness; [another] temporarily acted in his stead. On jiachen day [the acting appointee became] acting Governor-General of Zhili. On the jisi day of the ninth month he received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅解。兩廣總督。署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: relieved. Governor-General of Liangguang. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the eleventh month he was relieved from the post of Governor-General of Liangguang; [another] served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinmao: transferred. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 卒。八月癸卯署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Died. Eighth month, day guimao: acting Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: He died. On the guimao day of the eighth month [another] served as acting Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年癸亥

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 8, guihai.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth year of the Jiaqing reign (guihai).

sentences.zh: 六月戊子調。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi: transferred. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the sixth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 回本任。正月庚午兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Returned to original post. First month, day gengwu: Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to his original post. On the gengwu day of the first month he became Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年甲子

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 9, jiazi.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth year of the Jiaqing reign (jiazi).

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥卒。署陝甘總督。十一月己酉陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: died. Acting Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. Eleventh month, day jiyou: Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month he died; [another] served as acting Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. On the jiyou day of the eleventh month [the appointee became] Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 遷。十二月己酉兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Transferred. Twelfth month, day jiyou: Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred. On the jiyou day of the twelfth month he became Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 七月己亥卒。雲貴總督。署。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jihai: died. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the seventh month he died while serving as Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou; [another] served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅來京。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingyin: came to the capital. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month he came to the capital [while holding the post of] Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.

sentences.zh: 四月丙子來京。署。十二月丙寅遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingzi: came to the capital. Acting. Twelfth month, day bingyin: transferred. Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the fourth month he came to the capital and served in an acting capacity. On the bingyin day of the twelfth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年乙丑

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 10, yichou.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth year of the Jiaqing reign (yichou).

sentences.zh: 六月庚申降。直隸總督。十月辛丑遷。署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: demoted. Governor-General of Zhili. Tenth month, day xinchou: transferred. Acting Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the sixth month he was demoted to Governor-General of Zhili. On the xinchou day of the tenth month he was transferred and served as acting Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 正月辛亥遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: First month, day xinhai: transferred. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the first month he was transferred to Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申遷。湖廣總督。十一月丙辰革。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: transferred. Governor-General of Huguang. Eleventh month, day bingchen: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the sixth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Huguang. On the bingchen day of the eleventh month he was dismissed from that post.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑來京。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinchou: came to the capital. Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the tenth month he came to the capital [while holding the post of] Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十一年丙寅

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 11, bingyin.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh year of the Jiaqing reign (bingyin).

sentences.zh: 九月壬申卒。署。十月丁亥署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: died. Acting. Tenth month, day dinghai: acting Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the ninth month he died; [another] served in an acting capacity. On the dinghai day of the tenth month [the acting appointee became] acting Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申來京。陝甘總督。署。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiashen: came to the capital. Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the tenth month he came to the capital [while holding the post of] Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑統兵剿匪。署四川總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: commanded troops to suppress bandits. Acting Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the eleventh month he commanded troops to suppress bandits and served as acting Governor-General of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅革。閩浙總督。署。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang; [another] served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申遷。湖廣總督。署。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiashen: transferred. Governor-General of Huguang. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the tenth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Huguang and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 改副總河。六月庚寅江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Changed to Deputy Director-General of Rivers. Sixth month, day gengyin: Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Deputy Director-General of Rivers. On the gengyin day of the sixth month he became Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳革。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fourth month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十二年丁卯

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 12, dingmao.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year of the Jiaqing reign (dingmao).

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅授直隸總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: appointed Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the ninth month he was appointed Governor-General of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五月己未病免。陝甘總督。護。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. Guarded [the post].
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fifth month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu; [another] guarded the post for him.

sentences.zh: 五月己未遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: transferred. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fifth month he was transferred to Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十三年戊辰

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 13, wuchen.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth year of the Jiaqing reign (wuchen).

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午革。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eleventh month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰病免。江南河道總督。十二月庚申降。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control. Twelfth month, day gengshen: demoted. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the third month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control. On the gengshen day of the twelfth month he was demoted to Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: died. Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month he died while serving as Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 正月丙辰病免。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: First month, day bingchen: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the first month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午回籍。署。十一月丙辰憂。署。十二月辛巳來京。署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: returned to native place. Acting. Eleventh month, day bingchen: mourning leave. Acting. Twelfth month, day xinsi: came to the capital. Acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the ninth month he returned to his native place and another served in an acting capacity. On the bingchen day of the eleventh month he took mourning leave and another acted in his stead. On the xinsi day of the twelfth month the acting appointee came to the capital as acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子革。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuzi: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eighth month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: acting Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the ninth month he served as acting Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 道光二十三年癸卯

translations.literal: Daoguang year 23, guimao.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third year of the Daoguang reign, guimao cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌差。署。護。九月己酉仍回任。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: detached on special assignment. Acting. Guarded the post. Ninth month, day jiyou: still returned to post.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the third month he was detached on special assignment and another served in an acting capacity, guarding the post for him. On the jiyou day of the ninth month he still returned to his regular duties.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰病免。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the fifth month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申革。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wushen: dismissed from office. Governor-General of Hedong River Control.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the seventh month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Hedong River Control.

sentences.zh: 道光二十四年甲辰

translations.literal: Daoguang year 24, jiachen.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-fourth year of the Daoguang reign, jiachen cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌遷。兩江總督。護。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: transferred. Governor-General of Liangjiang. Guarded the post.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the second month he was transferred to Governor-General of Liangjiang and another guarded the post for him.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌病免。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the second month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳覲。兼雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: audience at court. Concurrently Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the eleventh month he had an audience at court while concurrently holding the post of Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申丁憂。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: mourning for father. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the third month he entered mourning for his father while holding the post of Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年乙巳

translations.literal: Daoguang year 25, yisi.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-fifth year of the Daoguang reign, yisi cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 四月壬子卒。任。署。十一月辛酉卒。陝甘總督。署。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renzi: died. In post. Acting. Eleventh month, day xinyou: died. Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the fourth month he died while still in post and another served in an acting capacity. On the xinyou day of the eleventh month the Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu died and another served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯免。雲貴總督。壬子覲。兼署。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guimao: dismissed. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. Day renzi: audience. Concurrently acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fourth month he was dismissed from the post of Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. On renzi day he had an audience at court while concurrently serving in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 正月庚午遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: First month, day gengwu: transferred. Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the first month he was transferred to Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 道光二十六年丙午

translations.literal: Daoguang year 26, bingwu.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-sixth year of the Daoguang reign, bingwu cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午來京。四川總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu: came to the capital. Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month he came to the capital while holding the post of Governor-General of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥降。雲貴總督。署。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: demoted. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the eighth month he was demoted to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申調。署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: transferred. Acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the twelfth month he was transferred and served as acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.

sentences.zh: 道光二十七年丁未

translations.literal: Daoguang year 27, dingwei.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-seventh year of the Daoguang reign, dingwei cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 正月乙酉覲。署。三月丁未遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: First month, day yiyou: audience at court. Acting. Third month, day dingwei: transferred. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the first month he had an audience at court and served in an acting capacity. On the dingwei day of the third month he was transferred to Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子赴肅州督剿。署。九月辛巳回陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: went to Suzhou to supervise suppression. Acting. Ninth month, day xinsi: returned as Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the eighth month he went to Suzhou to supervise military suppression and served in an acting capacity. On the xinsi day of the ninth month he returned to his post as Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌來京。署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: came to the capital. Acting Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month he came to the capital while serving as acting Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未調。雲貴總督。署。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: transferred. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the third month he was transferred to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 道光二十八年戊申

translations.literal: Daoguang year 28, wushen.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-eighth year of the Daoguang reign, wushen cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午留京。授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: remained at the capital. Appointed Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the sixth month he remained at the capital and was appointed Governor-General of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌病免。江南河道總督。署。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the ninth month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Jiangnan River Control and another served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年己酉

translations.literal: Daoguang year 29, jiyou.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-ninth year of the Daoguang reign, jiyou cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 四月壬寅病免。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renyin: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the fourth month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰病免。署陝甘總督。九月己酉實授。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: dismissed on account of illness. Acting Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. Ninth month, day jiyou: formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the ninth month he was dismissed on account of illness and another served as acting Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu. On the jiyou day of the ninth month the acting appointee received formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰調。署。己酉四川總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: transferred. Acting. Day jiyou: Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the ninth month he was transferred and served in an acting capacity. On jiyou day he became Governor-General of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 七月己未病免。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiwei: dismissed on account of illness. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the seventh month he was dismissed on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛未卒。河東河道總督。署。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day xinwei: died. Governor-General of Hedong River Control. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the intercalary fourth month the Governor-General of Hedong River Control died and another served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 道光三十年庚戌

translations.literal: Daoguang year 30, gengxu.
translations.idiomatic: The thirtieth year of the Daoguang reign, gengxu cyclical year.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午病卸。閩浙總督。署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: relieved on account of illness. Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month he was relieved on account of illness from the post of Governor-General of Fujian-Zhejiang and another served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午調。湖廣總督。署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: transferred. Governor-General of Huguang. Acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Governor-General of Huguang and served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午調。雲貴總督。十二月壬申署。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: transferred. Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. Twelfth month, day renshen: acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou. On the renshen day of the twelfth month he served in an acting capacity.
